name: Get All Users
sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

name: User Statistics
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM users GROUP BY status

name: Recent Orders
sql: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total, o.created_at, c.name as customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
description: Get orders from the last 7 days
